attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Occupational Therapy (LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education and continued-competency activities that count for NBCOT certification/renewal; the Board does not pre-approve courses (criteria and limits in Regulations Chapter 94).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First licensed after December 14 in either year of the 2-year period: no renewal until the following licensing period.
rules.audit_note: All licensees must track CE in an active CE Broker account; not using CE Broker may lead to an audit and discipline.
rules.legal_basis: S.C. Code Ann. §40-36 (Occupational Therapy Practice Act); S.C. Code Regs. ch. 94
rules.notes: Renewal also requires current NBCOT certification in good standing. Biennial renewal on or before March 15 of odd-numbered years; late penalty until April 16, then the license lapses.
rules.rule_quote: As a condition of license renewal, a licensee must complete satisfactorily sixteen hours of continuing education per biennium…
